main.description: A 60-second management ticket for one of the caller's instances, bound to the ticket key `keyProof` proves: a key the caller's browser generated and can't export. Send it to the instance as `Authorization: HV-Ticket <ticket>` with an `HV-Ticket-Proof` signed by that key for each request. Customers only.

keyProof.description: A compact JWS signed by the ticket key, with `typ: hv-key-proof+jwt` and its public JWK in the header. Claims: `aud`, HappyProto's instance's issuer URL; `lxm`, `at.happyproto.server.getManagementTicket`; `dpop_jkt`, the thumbprint of the DPoP key signing this request; `iat`; `jti`.

expiresAt.description: When the ticket expires, in Unix seconds.

audience.description: The instance the ticket names, as hpy:instance:<uuid>.

url.description: The instance's public URL, which the request proofs name.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: instance is missing or not a UUID, keyProof is missing, or HappyView refused keyProof.

errors.name: Unavailable
errors.description: No ticket can be issued for this sign-in: it isn't a DPoP session from the HappyProto dashboard. Signing in again fixes it.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such instance, or it is not the caller's. The two are indistinguishable.

errors.name: UnsupportedRelease
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: the instance's HappyView release predates tickets.

errors.name: TicketsDisabled
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: tickets are not turned on.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
